emails.otp.subject: Your KanaSanté verification code

emails.verificationApproved.subject: Your KanaSanté account is verified

emails.verificationApproved.body: Good news — your practitioner account has been verified. You are now visible to patients on KanaSanté.

emails.caregiverInvitation.subject: You've been invited on KanaSanté
emails.caregiverInvitation.heading: A caregiver invitation
emails.caregiverInvitation.body: Someone invited you to be linked as their dependent on KanaSanté so they can help manage your care. Use this code to accept: {token}
emails.receipt.subject: Your KanaSanté receipt {receiptNumber}
emails.receipt.heading: Payment received
emails.receipt.intro: Thank you — your payment has been received and your appointment is confirmed.
emails.receipt.closing: Keep this receipt to reconcile the charge with your mobile-money statement.
emails.reminder24h.subject: Reminder — appointment at {when}
emails.reminder24h.heading: Your appointment is tomorrow
emails.reminder24h.body: This is a reminder that your appointment with {practitioner} is scheduled for {when} (Douala time). If you can no longer attend, please cancel in the app so the slot can go to someone else.
emails.reminder1h.subject: Your appointment starts at {when}
emails.reminder1h.heading: Your appointment is starting soon
emails.reminder1h.body: Your appointment with {practitioner} starts at {when} (Douala time). Please make sure you are ready a few minutes ahead.
emails.appointment.booked-patient.body: We've received your appointment request with {practitioner} for {when} (Douala time). We'll confirm it as soon as your payment goes through.
emails.appointment.booked-practitioner.b: {patient} requested an appointment for {when} (Douala time). It will appear on your calendar once their payment is confirmed.
emails.appointment.confirmed-patient.bod: Your appointment with {practitioner} on {when} (Douala time) is confirmed. Your receipt follows in a separate email.
emails.appointment.rescheduled-patient.b: Your appointment with {practitioner} has been moved. New time: {when} (Douala time).
emails.appointment.rescheduled-practitio: {patient}'s appointment has been moved. New time: {when} (Douala time).
emails.appointment.cancelled-self.body: Your appointment with {practitioner} scheduled for {when} (Douala time) has been cancelled as requested. The slot is free again for rebooking.
{patient} cancelled the appointment scheduled for {when} (Douala time). The slot has been released.

emails.appointment.cancelled-self-practi: You cancelled {patient}'s appointment scheduled for {when} (Douala time). The slot has been released.
emails.appointment.cancelled-by-clinic.s: Appointment cancelled — your payment will be refunded
emails.appointment.cancelled-by-clinic.b: Your appointment with {practitioner} scheduled for {when} (Douala time) was cancelled by the clinic. Your full payment will be refunded — no action is needed.
emails.appointment.cancelled-by-clinic-p: An appointment was cancelled by the clinic
{patient}'s appointment scheduled for {when} (Douala time) was cancelled during a refund. The slot has been released.

emails.appointment.declined.heading: Your appointment request was declined
